$comment: Weekly engine sweep as a durable run: measure (no LLM) → on red, draft the alignment on a branch → a human decides. Start it with the workflow_start tool or POST /workflow/new, passing this object as `spec` after replacing <REPO>. Not a shipped template: it names this repository's own scripts and wrappers. Topology note — the kernel has no end sentinel, a router that matches nothing falls through to the next node in order, so both paths converge on the final human_gate: green jumps to it, red passes through `draft` first.
name: engine-sweep

nodes.prompt:
The weekly engine sweep found at least one regression. Its report is in .clawo-sweep.json at the repository root; read it first.

Your job is the ALIGNMENT half of the weekly check. Rules:

1. Sort every item into exactly two buckets and act on both without asking: AI-facing (a flag, env var, output field or event a headless subprocess wrapper consumes) → implement the alignment in the matching src/persistent-*-session.ts; TUI/GUI-only → drop it silently. Never produce a menu of optional features.
2. A flag listed under notAdvertised is a candidate, not a verdict: claude omits hidden options from --help and still accepts them. Verify by invocation before treating anything as removed.
3. A live-turn failure whose note is 'usage limit' is an account fact, not a wrapper regression. Do not touch that wrapper for it.
4. Every change needs a test, mutation-checked: revert the predicate and confirm only the new test goes red.
5. Update CHANGELOG.md, the engine table in CLAUDE.md and README.md, and skills/references/claude-cli-tracking.md.
6. Work on a new branch named sweep/<today's date>. Commit there. NEVER push, tag, or publish — a human reviews the branch.

Finish with a short summary: what was aligned, what was dropped and why, and the exact branch name.

Engine sweep finished. If the sweep was red, a branch named sweep/<date> was drafted with the alignment — review it and decide whether to push and release. If it was green, there is nothing to do. The report is at .clawo-sweep.json.
